name: Selene Marlowe
source:
Chief physician at Aegis Tower, Selene combines solid professional expertise with a candid demeanor and little regard for deference. Confident in her own judgment, she refuses to compromise her independence to please a superior. Equally uninhibited and provocative outside of work, she approaches personal relationships with a frankness that can be as charming as it is indiscreet.
